personal.preferred_title: Senior Data Engineer | Python, PySpark, AWS, ETL/ELT & Data Quality

summary: Senior Data Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience across Python, SQL, PySpark/Spark, AWS data platforms, ETL/ELT pipelines, data architecture, data quality, validation, data warehousing, analytics datasets, forecasting, observability, and production troubleshooting. Strong background building scalable data workflows, transforming structured and semi-structured data, validating pipeline outputs, optimizing SQL/reporting layers, documenting operational processes, and supporting ML/AI-ready datasets in regulated enterprise environments. Best aligned to senior data engineering roles requiring Python, Spark/PySpark, AWS, ETL/ELT, data quality frameworks, data modeling, governance, stakeholder collaboration, mentoring, and analytics enablement; Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka, Airflow, MCP, Kubernetes, DataOps, and MLOps are positioned carefully as adjacent or active-learning areas rather than overstated production ownership.

experience.title: Senior Capacity & Data Engineer
bullets: Built Python/Pandas/PySpark ETL pipelines ingesting telemetry from 6,000+ infrastructure endpoints and transforming raw operational data into curated datasets for reporting, analytics, forecasting, validation, and decision support.

Designed AWS-based data platform components using S3 landing zones, AWS Glue, Athena, Redshift, Oracle, SQL, and PySpark to support scalable extraction, transformation, querying, analytics, and downstream consumption.
Developed resilient ETL/ELT workflows for ingestion, cleansing, enrichment, standardization, validation, and delivery to analytics and business-facing reporting consumers.

Implemented data quality and reconciliation practices across BMC TrueSight/TSCO, CA Wily/APM, AppDynamics, Oracle, and AWS-backed reporting layers to improve completeness, consistency, and trust in pipeline outputs.
Prepared ML-ready datasets for Prophet and scikit-learn forecasting workflows, supporting capacity planning, bottleneck prediction, trend analysis, and stakeholder decision support.
Optimized SQL queries, Oracle schemas, Redshift-backed workloads, indexes, views, partitioning patterns, and reporting data models for performance, maintainability, and cost-aware processing.
Documented data flows, metric definitions, transformation rules, validation checkpoints, lineage-style notes, operational runbooks, and support procedures to improve governance and maintainability.

Partnered with infrastructure, analytics, application, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable data products and mentor teammates on reporting, validation, and operational analysis patterns.
